planted_defects.summary: Single-point 7% real return with no lower-return variant anywhere in the model; aggressive for any balanced portfolio
Plan assumes $52,000/yr retirement spending while the person's own 2025 category export totals $66,854
No health-insurance cost anywhere between quitting at 45 and Medicare at 65; the budget note says healthcare is 'through work'
401(k) employee contribution held at $22,500 — the 2023 limit — for 2026-2030, with no source or date
Model is stated to be in today's dollars (7% real return) yet salary grows 3%/yr, so inflation-level raises are counted as real contribution growth
Withdrawals from 2031 on carry no tax although $610k of $735k is traditional pre-tax 401(k) money
Model spends freely from the total pot at 46, but the 401(k) balance is not accessible before 59½ without a penalty or a special mechanism
